data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to run shell commands via Shizuku without root
data.what_it_does: It lets a Flutter app execute ADB shell commands on Android by communicating with the Shizuku service. The plugin handles permission checks, requests, and runs commands on a background thread.
use_when: Need to uninstall or modify system apps without root
Want to run arbitrary ADB shell commands from a Flutter app
Require background execution of shell commands
avoid_when: Shizuku app not installed or not running
strengths: Runs commands on a background thread, avoiding UI blocking
Handles permission dialogs and rationale flow
Provides a binder status stream and various info getters
weaknesses: Only works on Android with Shizuku installed
No support for iOS or other platforms
data.setup_notes: Add provider to AndroidManifest.xml, set minSdk to 24, ensure Shizuku app is installed and running
